notes: system is a top-level field, not a message; max_tokens is REQUIRED.
tools are {name, description, input_schema}; tool_choice is {type: auto|any|tool|none, name?}.
SSE: message_start > content_block_start > content_block_delta(text/thinking/input_json) > content_block_stop > message_delta(stop_reason+usage) > message_stop; rebuild into OpenAI chunks + [DONE].
stop_reason map: end_turn->stop, max_tokens->length, tool_use->tool_calls, stop_sequence->stop, refusal->content_filter.
An OpenAI-compatible /v1/ base exists but is labeled test/eval-only, non-production -> use the native adapter.
prompt caching via cache_control{type:ephemeral,ttl?}; cache_read =0.1x input, 5m cache_write =1.25x, 1h cache_write =2x base input.

prompt_cache_min_tokens (capabilities) is the model's minimum cacheable prefix per first-party docs (4096 Opus-tier + Haiku 4.5, 2048 Fable 5; Sonnet 5 assumed 2048 = its family tier, unconfirmed first-party). The API silently ignores markers below the real minimum, so an understated value is a free no-op while an overstated one suppresses live caching -- when unsure, go lower. The gateway uses it only to avoid emitting dead markers.
